questions.sectionTitle: Module 3: DAX Analytics & Executive Reporting Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why must `Net Sales` across `Quantity * UnitPrice` columns inside a Measure use `SUMX` rather than `SUM`?

options.text: `SUM` accepts only a single column reference without row context; `SUMX` iterates row-by-row over the table evaluating the multiplication

questions.explanation: Row iterators (`SUMX`, `MINX`, `AVERAGEX`) step across row context prior to aggregating.
questions.topic: DAX Fundamentals: Row vs Filter Context, SUMX & CALCULATE
questions.recommendedLessonTitle: DAX Fundamentals: Row vs Filter Context, SUMX & CALCULATE

questions.sectionTitle: Module 3: DAX Analytics & Executive Reporting Checkpoint
questions.prompt: How does `ALLSELECTED(Products)` behave inside `CALCULATE()` differently from `ALL(Products)`?

options.text: `ALLSELECTED` restores filters originating from external page/report slicers while clearing visual inner row groupings; `ALL` removes ALL filters unconditionally
Both behave identically in every matrix

questions.explanation: `ALLSELECTED` keeps report-level slicer interactivity accurate on percentages.
questions.topic: DAX Fundamentals: Row vs Filter Context, SUMX & CALCULATE

questions.sectionTitle: Module 3: DAX Analytics & Executive Reporting Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why wrap ratios in `DIVIDE(numerator, denominator)` instead of `numerator / denominator`?

options.text: `DIVIDE` gracefully catches zero or blank denominators returning BLANK/fallback without crashing visuals with `Infinity`

questions.topic: DAX Fundamentals: Row vs Filter Context, SUMX & CALCULATE
questions.recommendedLessonTitle: DAX Fundamentals: Row vs Filter Context, SUMX & CALCULATE

questions.sectionTitle: Module 3: DAX Analytics & Executive Reporting Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why do bar charts with 12–15 categories strongly beat circular pie charts in executive BI design?

options.text: Human eyes judge linear aligned bar lengths and sorted order vastly more accurately than comparing angular pie slice areas
Pie charts cannot accept DAX measures
Bar charts bypass database Row-Level Security
Pie charts break Power Query folding

questions.explanation: Sorted horizontal bars make multi-category comparisons effortless and precise.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 3: DAX Analytics & Executive Reporting Checkpoint
questions.prompt: What happens in a `Revenue YoY %` metric if you compute `(Cur - Prev) / Prev` in upcoming un-elapsed months where `Cur` is BLANK?

options.text: `Cur - Prev` evaluates to `-Prev`, rendering an alarming fake `-100%` line drop unless guarded with `NOT ISBLANK(Cur)`
Power BI hides future months automatically
DAX throws an exception halting report load

questions.explanation: Always guard period-over-period deltas against un-elapsed blank periods.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 3: DAX Analytics & Executive Reporting Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Which DAX function dynamically matches the currently logged-in report viewer's identity in Row-Level Security filters?
questions.explanation: `USERPRINCIPALNAME()` maps dynamically to the authenticated viewer's account UPN.
